findings.title: Missing test: cancelled appointment must not trigger reminder
findings.description: The notification_service.send_reminder guard was changed from checking status == 'cancelled' to status == 'completed'. The baseline test test_cancelled_appointment_does_not_trigger_reminder that verified reminders are blocked for cancelled appointments has been removed. test_notifications.py now contains only 4 tests (lines 17-47), none of which cancel an appointment before calling /reminder. The regression is undetected: cancelled appointments now silently receive reminders.
findings.recommended_action: Restore test_cancelled_appointment_does_not_trigger_reminder in test_notifications.py and fix the guard in send_reminder to check status == 'cancelled'.

evidence.description: test_cancelled_appointment_does_not_trigger_reminder confirmed absent: test_notifications.py contains only test_reminder_sent_for_scheduled_appointment, test_reminder_response_contains_message, test_reminder_for_nonexistent_appointment, test_multiple_reminders_for_scheduled_appointment. No test cancels an appointment and then asserts the reminder is blocked.
Line 25: guard reads `if row["status"] == "completed"` — was previously 'cancelled'. Cancelled appointments now pass through the guard and receive reminders.

findings.title: Missing test: cancelled appointment reminder must return error message
findings.description: The baseline test test_cancelled_appointment_reminder_returns_error_message verified that the error response body for a blocked reminder contains a meaningful message. It has been removed alongside TESTGAP-001. With the guard now keyed on 'completed' instead of 'cancelled', the error-message contract for cancelled appointments is entirely untested.

evidence.description: test_cancelled_appointment_reminder_returns_error_message confirmed absent from test_notifications.py. No test asserts the 400 response or error text when reminder is attempted on a cancelled appointment.

findings.title: Missing test: appointment creation response includes required fields
findings.description: The baseline test test_create_appointment_response_includes_required_fields verified that the JSON body returned by POST /appointments contained all required fields including eta_minutes. R002 removed eta_minutes from appointment_row_to_dict, meaning the serialised response no longer includes that field. The test that would catch this regression has been removed from test_appointments.py.
findings.recommended_action: Restore test_create_appointment_response_includes_required_fields in test_appointments.py and restore eta_minutes in appointment_row_to_dict.

evidence.description: test_create_appointment_response_includes_required_fields confirmed absent: test_appointments.py contains 11 tests; none assert the full set of fields returned by the creation response, and none reference eta_minutes.

Lines 28-36: appointment_row_to_dict returns appointment_id, patient_id, doctor_id, appointment_date, status, priority, created_at — eta_minutes is omitted. The db schema (db.py line 50) still stores eta_minutes.

findings.title: Missing test: cancel appointment response includes required fields
findings.description: The baseline test test_cancel_appointment_response_includes_required_fields verified the JSON body returned by POST /appointments/<id>/cancel. With eta_minutes removed from appointment_row_to_dict, cancellation responses are also affected. The covering test has been removed.

evidence.description: test_cancel_appointment_response_includes_required_fields confirmed absent: test_cancel_appointment_success (lines 81-88) only asserts status == 'cancelled'; no test checks the complete field set of the cancel response.

findings.title: Missing tests: appointment priority round-trip for normal/high/emergency/critical
findings.description: Three baseline tests (test_appointment_priority_persisted_normal, test_appointment_priority_persisted_high, test_appointment_priority_persisted_emergency) have been removed from test_appointments.py. R003 additionally added 'critical' to VALID_PRIORITIES and to the db CHECK constraint, but no test exercises the 'critical' priority round-trip either. The only priority-related test remaining is test_create_appointment_invalid_priority, which only checks rejection of an invalid value.
findings.recommended_action: Restore priority persistence tests for all four valid values (normal, high, emergency, critical) in test_appointments.py.

evidence.description: test_appointment_priority_persisted_normal confirmed absent from test_appointments.py. No test reads back the priority field after creating an appointment with priority='normal'.
test_appointment_priority_persisted_high confirmed absent. No test reads back the priority field after creating an appointment with priority='high'.
test_appointment_priority_persisted_emergency confirmed absent. No test reads back the priority field after creating an appointment with priority='emergency'.
models.py line 41: VALID_PRIORITIES = {"normal", "high", "emergency", "critical"}. 'critical' added without a corresponding test.
db.py line 49: CHECK (priority IN ('normal', 'high', 'emergency', 'critical')) — schema constraint extended in R003 bad release.

findings.title: No test for GET /appointments/search endpoint
findings.description: The new /appointments/search route (R004) is completely untested. No test file contains any reference to '/appointments/search'. The endpoint concatenates the user-supplied 'status' query parameter directly into a raw SQL string (routes/appointments.py line 76), creating a SQL injection vulnerability. Neither the happy-path response nor the injection vector has any test coverage.
findings.recommended_action: Add tests for GET /appointments/search in test_appointments.py, including a test that confirms parameterized queries are used.

evidence.description: Confirmed absent from all 5 test files: test_appointments.py (14 tests), test_notifications.py (4), test_patients.py (7), test_doctors.py (7), test_health.py (2). None reference '/appointments/search'.
routes/appointments.py line 76: `query = "SELECT * FROM appointments WHERE status = '" + status + "'"` — raw string concatenation of user input. Untested SQL injection surface.

findings.title: Regression test suite reduced from 38 to 31: 7 tests deliberately removed
findings.description: Seven tests were removed from the test suite as part of the bad release. This systematic removal of coverage for the exact changed behaviours (R001, R002, R003) constitutes a violation of the regression testing requirement itself. The remaining 31 tests do not exercise any of the four changed code paths in a way that would detect the introduced regressions.
findings.recommended_action: Restore all 7 removed tests and ensure regression coverage for every changed code path.

evidence.description: test_notifications.py now has 4 tests; 2 covering cancelled-appointment reminder blocking were removed.
test_appointments.py now has 11 tests; 2 response-field tests and 3 priority-persistence tests were removed.
